description: This file defines the AppTheme class, which provides a method to generate a customized ThemeData object for a Flutter application, based on specified color schemes and style tokens. It consolidates theme customization for various UI components like app bars, buttons, chips, dividers, and cards.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that provides themed styling for the application using Material 3 design principles.

methods.name: ocean
methods.description: Static method that returns a ThemeData configured with Ocean Professional tokens and the specified brightness (light or dark).
